fusions.name: Head-Down Stampede
fusions.desc: Charges through a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Driven Hard
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Unhurried Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fresh Off the Pasture
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
